decisions.reason: It remains tightly aligned with our border and travel-security knowledge base, and its established governmental adoption gives us strong evidence and feedback to keep improving it commercially.

It is still related enough to our specialist detection and operational-security capabilities to justify continued learning, but its higher analytical and regulatory complexity keeps withdrawal risk materially above our stronger products.

It fits closely with our document-verification and passenger-processing capabilities and supports integrated customer workflows, so our existing know-how is sufficient to continue developing and selling it.
